## Summary
Implement graph-aware chunking that splits LectureSection text into ContentChunk nodes of 150-250 tokens with 30-token overlap, aligned to entity boundaries.

## User story
As a platform engineer, I want lecture text to be chunked at consistent, entity-aware boundaries, so that embeddings and entity extraction operate on coherent semantic units rather than arbitrary text splits.

## Why this matters
Chunk quality directly determines embedding quality, which determines TEACHES edge accuracy, which determines SubConcept completeness, which determines assessment quality. Chunks that are too large dilute embeddings; too small lose context; split mid-entity create orphan references. Rule 12 (D04) parameters are canonical and non-negotiable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] packages/ai/chunker.ts exports `graphAwareChunk(text: string): ContentChunk[]`
- [ ] Every chunk is 150-250 tokens (enforced, not approximate)
- [ ] 30-token overlap between consecutive chunks
- [ ] Entity boundaries respected: no chunk splits mid-sentence
- [ ] ContentChunk rows created in Supabase with: lecture_section_id, chunk_order, text, token_count
- [ ] ContentChunk nodes created in Neo4j via neo4jQuery
- [ ] HAS_CHUNK edge: LectureSection → ContentChunk (with chunk_order property)
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] Speaker note text is NEVER present in any ContentChunk (AP-11)
- [ ] Chunks <140 or >260 tokens throw a validation error (hard boundary)

## Canonical decisions in play

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// packages/ai/chunker.ts
interface ContentChunkOutput {
  text: string
  tokenCount: number
  chunkOrder: number
  overlapTokens: number
}

const MIN_TOKENS = 150
const MAX_TOKENS = 250
const OVERLAP_TOKENS = 30

export function graphAwareChunk(text: string): ContentChunkOutput[] {
  const sentences = splitIntoSentences(text)
  const chunks: ContentChunkOutput[] = []
  let currentTokens: string[] = []
  let currentCount = 0
  let chunkOrder = 0

  for (const sentence of sentences) {
    const sentenceTokens = tokenize(sentence)

    if (currentCount + sentenceTokens.length > MAX_TOKENS && currentCount >= MIN_TOKENS) {
      // Emit chunk
      chunks.push({
        text: detokenize(currentTokens),
        tokenCount: currentCount,
        chunkOrder: chunkOrder++,
        overlapTokens: OVERLAP_TOKENS,
      })

      // Keep overlap
      const overlapStart = Math.max(0, currentTokens.length - OVERLAP_TOKENS)
      currentTokens = currentTokens.slice(overlapStart)
      currentCount = currentTokens.length
    }

    currentTokens.push(...sentenceTokens)
    currentCount += sentenceTokens.length
  }

  // Emit final chunk (may be < MIN_TOKENS — merge with previous if so)
  if (currentCount > 0) {
    if (currentCount < MIN_TOKENS && chunks.length > 0) {
      // Merge with previous chunk
      const prev = chunks[chunks.length - 1]
      prev.text = prev.text + ' ' + detokenize(currentTokens)
      prev.tokenCount = tokenize(prev.text).length
    } else {
      chunks.push({
        text: detokenize(currentTokens),
        tokenCount: currentCount,
        chunkOrder: chunkOrder++,
        overlapTokens: 0,
      })
    }
  }

  // Validate all chunks
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    if (chunk.tokenCount < 140 || chunk.tokenCount > 260) {
      throw new Error(`Chunk ${chunk.chunkOrder} has ${chunk.tokenCount} tokens — outside D04 range [140, 260]`)
    }
  }

  return chunks
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Rule 12: Arbitrary split without entity boundaries
const chunks = text.match(/.{1,500}/g) // WRONG — arbitrary character split

// ✗ Rule 12: No overlap
const chunks = splitByTokenCount(text, 200, 0) // WRONG — 0 overlap

// ✗ Rule 12: Chunks outside range
const chunks = splitByTokenCount(text, 500, 30) // WRONG — 500 > 250

// ✗ AP-11: Including speaker notes
const fullText = section.raw_text + section.speaker_notes_raw
const chunks = graphAwareChunk(fullText) // WRONG — speaker notes contamination
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S05.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S05: Graph-aware chunking', () => {
  test('All chunks are within 140-260 token range (D04)', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      for (const chunk of data) {
        expect(chunk.token_count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(140)
        expect(chunk.token_count).toBeLessThanOrEqual(260)
      }
    }
  })

  test('Chunks have correct ordering', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      const sorted = [...data].sort((a: any, b: any) => a.chunk_order - b.chunk_order)
      for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
        expect(sorted[i].chunk_order).toBe(i)
      }
    }
  })

  test('Consecutive chunks have 30-token overlap', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      if (data.length >= 2) {
        // Verify overlap: end of chunk N should appear at start of chunk N+1
        for (let i = 0; i < data.length - 1; i++) {
          const currentEnd = data[i].text.split(/\s+/).slice(-30).join(' ')
          const nextStart = data[i + 1].text.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 30).join(' ')
          // At least some overlap should exist
          expect(currentEnd.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
          expect(nextStart.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('AP-11: No speaker note text in any chunk', async ({ request }) => {
    const notesRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/speaker-notes`
    )
    const chunksRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (notesRes.ok() && chunksRes.ok()) {
      const { data: notes } = await notesRes.json()
      const { data: chunks } = await chunksRes.json()
      for (const note of notes) {
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          expect(chunk.text).not.toContain(note.text)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('Negative: empty text produces no chunks', async ({ request }) => {
    // Unit test — verify chunker handles empty input
    // This would be a unit test in packages/ai/__tests__/chunker.test.ts
    expect(true).toBe(true) // Placeholder for unit test
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS content_chunks;`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (cc:ContentChunk) DETACH DELETE cc`
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
